input.summary: Extend Services licence to Affiliates and contractors and remove revocation at Vendor's discretion
input.comment: [Playbook] We extended the Services licence to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, and replaced revocation at Vendor's sole discretion with the notice-and-cure standard already agreed in Section 13.3. Our playbook requires operational use by affiliates and contractors and a licence that cannot be pulled at will; if helpful we can instead cover Affiliates on written notice as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
ops.newText: Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer's behalf a licence to use the Services, revocable or suspendable only as permitted by Section 13.3 and transferable to an Affiliate or successor in accordance with Section 13.3.
